notes.title: Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise now available!
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

The sequel to Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox, "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109570/Bombing_2_A_Graffiti_Paradise/]Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise[/url]" is now available on Steam!

It features a higher fidelity of paint, larger environments, way more tools to play with and unlock, and all new characters and locales!

Thanks for your support, and if you enjoy Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox I'd highly encourage you to check it out! :)

- Devon

notes.title: Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise Available To Wishlist!
notes.content:
Hello artists!

Just posting an update to let you know I've just announced a sequel to Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox called "[b]Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise[/b]"!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109570/Bombing_2_A_Graffiti_Paradise/]Here's a link to the Steam store page![/url][/b]

It's been a long development process so far, but Bombing!! 2 is being developed with a lot of your excellent and very valid feedback from Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox in mind. ːsteamhappyː

[b]To list just a few features Bombing!! 2 will have:[/b]
- An eraser tool in case you make a mistake!
- A colour picker instead of a limited colour palette!
- Higher-resolution textures!
- Custom graphics importer!
- Much larger maps!
- Adjustable environment settings!
- A camera with adjustable filter options!
- More exploration opportunity!

And here's just a few examples of cool art that has been made in it so far!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/042fb0c603a2e4255e7e01775b4c34a052af86df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/890e82ef1db4a18f1d15c8c3f8bc9081fe62e5bc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/ce7d27d8d076a07c6756cd0321194cb747f84436.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/b59981438574099219c71870687409a5ca8db8ef.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/fe2c0b900d25894dde9390e6bc45d1ca4cd99373.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/89550c9443e2063ae1e9c820601003e597faac2a.png[/img][/url]

If any of this sounds fun or exciting I'd invite you to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109570/Bombing_2_A_Graffiti_Paradise/?beta=0]check out the Store page and Wishlist it on Steam[/url][/b] or hop on over to the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/xJTrVwa2g4]Developer Discord[/url][/b] to keep tabs on future updates!

Thanks for all your support with Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox, and I'm very excited to share more about Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise as development continues :)

- Devon

notes.title: Final Update: The Paint Roller!
notes.content:
What's up, artists? I'm happy to announce that paint rollers have been added to the Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox toolkit!

You can access the paint roller by interacting with the cans of paint included in the backpack. It works similar to the paint pens - you can use it by looking at a wall and holding down the left mouse button. It's best used to reliably cover those tough-to-reach areas and cover large areas of walls, and it comes in the same colour swatches as the paint cans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686154/508a49d6983fcc8c35a50144150e5e3d5fa37f9b.gif[/img]

I've also added a "Filter" option to the Options menu which will allow you to turn off the camera's pixel filter. A few people have given the feedback that it's too harsh or off-putting. Be warned: It's not how the game was designed to look, so it might make some sections of the world look at little bit funky!

---

Finally, I'd like to announce that this will likely be the last update for Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox - I'm working on a couple new game projects and unfortunately didn't anticipate how much upkeep maintaing Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox would take, and no longer have the time to add new features to the game or support it further.

If you enjoyed your time with Bombing!!:A Graffiti Sandbox please feel free to leave it a review, and if you'd like to follow along with what I'm creating next you're welcome to [url=https://discord.com/invite/xJTrVwa2g4]join my Discord[/url] server.

Thank you to everyone who has picked up and played Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox; I truly appreciate the support you've all shown, and I hope you all continue creating more and more amazing pieces for a long time to come!

- Devon

notes.title: Thank you, Roadmap, Artwork Submissions!
notes.content:
[i]Hello Bombers![/i] 

Devon here, the developer of [b]Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox[/b]. It's been a few months since release and I figured it's about time that I should post an update about the game and fill you in on a few things that's been going on.

[h3]Thank you[/h3]
First off I just wanted to thank everyone for supporting [b]Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox[/b] so far! I don't have any long-term plans for the game's roadmap as I've largely moved onto new game projects, but it's my first independent release on Steam and the reception has been overwhelming so far!

I've been checking in daily on the awesome ways people have been getting creative with the game and I'm always blown away by the phenomenal things you've all been sharing in the community pages!

[h3]Upcoming Paint Roller Update[/h3]
While I may not have any plans for huge updates or additions to the game, I *have* been working on a update which will introduce a Paint Roller as a new tool in your arsenal. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39686154/508a49d6983fcc8c35a50144150e5e3d5fa37f9b.gif[/img]

It works similarly to the Pen tool and will allow you to cover larger areas and basically make coating walls and locations much easier. It also includes the same amount of colour options as the spray can!

I anticipate it will roll out some time in the next couple months (probably coinciding with a Steam sale), so keep an eye out for that! It will likely be the last big addition to the game, but I hope it helps give you another tool to make sweet stuff with!

[h3]Screenshot Submissions[/h3]
As a part of the upcoming update, I wanted to incorporate more community pieces into the game (including areas like loading screens, store pages, the main menu) but I also don't want to do it without your permission! 

If you'd like your art featured more prominently on the game's materials please feel free to comment in the discussions and include a link to your awesome pieces for me to use. You've all created so much cool stuff that I'd love to showcase to even more people!



Thank you again for all the support you've shown for [b]Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox![/b] Please don't forget to leave a review if you've enjoyed your time with it, and feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/xJTrVwa2g4]join my Discord server[/url] to share your work and chat about the game with even more people! 

I look forward to seeing what wild creations you make with the upcoming Paint Roller, and I hope y'all continue to cover those walls in some amazing art :)
